text:
alice: heads up — since last kernel roll we’re seeing intermittent RX/TX errors and RDMA tears on p5zn gpu pools in use1-lax. pods experiencing degraded east-west throughput, some jobs falling back to TCP.

omar: yup, alerted by perf:link — latency spikes and packet drops on node i-0a1b2c (p5zn). traces show retries + RDMA fallback.

yuki: what do ethtool stats show?

alice:
```
# ethtool -S ens5 | egrep 'rx_errors|tx_errors|rx_dropped|tx_dropped'
rx_errors: 124
tx_errors: 98
rx_dropped: 46
tx_dropped: 2
```

yuki: dmesg shows repeated firmware messages:
```
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: NIC firmware mismatch: driver expects v2.1, device FW v1.8
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: Resetting port due to TX timeout
```

ben: @alice can you confirm MTU? If MTU mismatch we’ll see fragmentation + errors.

alice: MTU is 9000 on host and 1500 in container overlay for some older workloads — good catch. overlay is using flannel VXLAN.

omar: overlay MTU mismatch + firmware mismatch = recipe for reorders/err. We should avoid container MTU override or enable hostNetwork for critical pods as short-term.

yuki: vendor has a release note: new kernel driver expects device FW >=2.0 or you must pin driver to 1.9. Options:
- push NIC FW upgrade 2.0 via vendor tool (requires reboot)
- roll back driver package to 1.9 (no reboot but requires module reload)
- set kernel param to disable RDMA offload (workaround)

ben: ops proposal: schedule canary to two nodes in us-east-1 with FW upgrade after maintenance window; meanwhile pin driver to 1.9 on remaining nodes and set traffic steering to avoid these NICs.

alice: started a playbook: runbook link https://redwood-internal/playbooks/nic-fw-roll.json :eyes: 

infra-bot: deployment job 2145 queued for nodes i-0a1b2c and i-0d3e4f :gear:

omar: after rollback + MTU fix, packets normalized. follow-ups: add firmware-version check to node-prober, alert when driver/firmware mismatch >0.

yuki: also add MTU consistency check between host and overlay during provisioning.

alice: thanks team — will open follow-up PRs for node-prober alert and terraform change for interface MTU.
